caption: Fig. 2(b) — Per-level 3x3 neighbourhood search (2-D schematic of the 3x3x3 in 3-D). Query q (red cross) maps to center cell (i,j) via floor(q/delta) (blue). Orange cells: the 8 neighbour offsets (di,dj) in {-1,0,+1}^2; labelled with their integer offsets. Green triangles: all candidate elements from the 9-cell window that undergo PIT tests. The 3x3 window is guaranteed to contain all four vertex cells of any Kuhn element whose parent hexahedral cell overlaps the query position (Theorem 4.1).
description: Print-ready figure for Section 4.5. White background.
